description: This file defines the internal implementation of the ClusterClient class within the Orleans framework. It includes constructors, lifecycle management methods (StartAsync, StopAsync), grain factory methods (GetGrain, CreateObjectReference, DeleteObjectReference), and logging functions. The class is responsible for managing client communication with Orleans clusters, lifecycle events, and grain references.

classes.name: ClusterClient
classes.description: Internal class implementing the Orleans cluster client, managing lifecycle, grain references, and communication with the cluster.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Starts the cluster client asynchronously, initiating runtime and lifecycle start procedures.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the cluster client asynchronously, handling shutdown procedures and cleanup.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a grain reference of specified type using various primary key types or strings.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates an object reference for a grain observer or addressable object.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Deletes an object reference for a grain observer.
